summary: Electro-Sensors filed an 8-K reporting entry into a definitive merger agreement. Under the deal, a subsidiary of steute Industrial Controls will acquire Electro-Sensors for $7.75 per share in cash. The board approved and recommended the merger. Conditions include shareholder approval, no material adverse effect, and no more than 10% dissenters. A $1.0M termination fee plus up to $300k expense reimbursement applies. The deal is expected to close after shareholder approval. Watch for shareholder vote timeline and any competing bids.
